findings.correction: If he'd gotten up, he should have woken me so we could at least have a bowl of hangover soup.
findings.current: If I had woken up, he should have woken me too, so we could at least have a bowl of hangover soup.
findings.defect: Omitted subject is Jinho, already collapsed/idle; the draft makes Taekyung the one who woke.
findings.rationale: 자빠진 거야 frames Jinho as the one who should have risen and then woken Taekyung; 날 깨웠어야 requires Jinho as waker, not Taekyung waking himself.
findings.source: 일어났으면 해장국이라도 한 그릇 하자고 날 깨웠어야 했다.

findings.correction: In other words, they were modern-day Murim martial artists.
findings.current: In other words, modern-day martial artists from Murim.
findings.defect: 현대판 무림인들 are modern equivalents of Murim people on Earth; from Murim reads as origin in Murim.
findings.rationale: 현대판 marks analogy, not travel from Murim; locative from changes who they are.

findings.correction: I had to think of it that way if I was going to hold on.
findings.current: I have to do this if I want to hold out.
findings.defect: 이렇게라도 continues the coping thought (call the slow Third Stage good enough), not the need to train.
findings.rationale: Immediately follows 그렇게 생각하려고 노력 중이다; the pronoun target is that attitude, not spear practice.

findings.defect: Adds an unstated form number; 이 초식 is this form, not 이 초식.
findings.rationale: Only 일 초식 is numbered; assigning Second Form invents a technique identity the source does not name.

findings.correction: The Hyuk Mujin projected here was a fist fighter.
findings.current: The Hyuk Mujin projected here was a boxer.
findings.defect: 권사 is a fist-using martial artist, not a Western boxer; the chapter already used 권투 for boxing.
findings.rationale: Hanja 拳士 and the later 주먹/발을 보면 reading mark Murim unarmed fighting, not boxing.
findings.source: 이 자리에 투영해 낸 혁무진은 권사(拳士)다.

findings.correction: It was an attack F-rank Hunter Jin Taekyung couldn't perform. But Jin Taekyung the Murim martial artist, drawing up internal energy, could.
findings.current: It was an attack F-rank Hunter Jin Taekyung couldn't perform. But martial artist Jin Taekyung, who could draw on internal energy, could do it.
findings.defect: The contrast is Hunter vs 무림인, not Hunter vs generic martial artist.
findings.rationale: 무림인 is the series term for a person of Murim; collapsing it to martial artist erases the Hunter/Murim split the sentence is built on.
findings.source: F급 헌터 진태경은 할 수 없는 공격. 그러나 공력을 끌어 올린 무림인 진태경이라면 가능하다.

findings.defect: 어딜 intercepts the approach (don't you dare / where do you think you're going); it is not a command to leave.
findings.rationale: Spoken as he swings the shaft to stop Hyuk closing; telling him to get away reverses the speech act.

findings.correction: Finding this fun in a situation like this meant I was pretty damn crazy, too.
findings.current: Feeling excited in a situation like this meant I was pretty damn crazy, too.
findings.defect: 재미 is finding it fun, matching 재미있는 싸움 and the illusion's 재미?; excited changes the emotion.
findings.rationale: The punchline is amusement at a duel to the death, not adrenaline-excitement.
findings.source: 이 상황에서 재미를 느끼다니. 나도 어지간히 미친놈이다.

findings.correction: Use a normal blockquote (or a News heading), not a System window.
findings.current:
> **System**
>
> **Chinese Martial Arts Alliance: Twenty-Five Members Massacred in an F-Rank Gate. More Than Half Confirmed Dead from Goblin Poison Needles…**
findings.defect: This is a news headline he remembers, not a game System panel.
findings.rationale: The surrounding prose is 뉴스 1면; System heading is reserved for actual System UI.
findings.source: - 중화 무술 연맹 소속 25인. F급 게이트에서 몰살. 그중 절반 이상이 고블린 독침에 의해 사망한 것으로 밝혀져…….

findings.correction: It was the final form of the Jin Family's Spear Technique: Cheongwanil.
findings.current: It was the final form of the Jin Family's Spear Technique: the Sky-Piercing Strike.
findings.defect: 천관일 is not in the binding glossary; Sky-Piercing Strike invents a grand English technique name.
findings.rationale: Uncertain source names must not be upgraded into coined heroic titles.

findings.correction: That so-called goshiwon manager. Add a first-use footnote: a goshiwon is cheap cubicle boarding, often for exam students.
findings.current: That guy's the manager of the goshiwon.
findings.defect: 고시원 is left unexplained, and 라는 양반이 sarcasm is flattened.
findings.rationale: Binding footnote rules require a brief 고시원 note when the living arrangement matters; the line also mocks the title, not merely states it.

findings.correction: **Lv. 20 Hyuk Mujin**, **Lv. 10 Cheon Ryeokbu** (no square brackets inside the panel).
findings.defect: System windows keep square brackets around UI names.
findings.rationale: The System heading and blockquote already mark the panel; inner [] are forbidden.

findings.defect: Marked as spoken dialogue; source uses the chapter's thought quotes, before he talks to the illusion.
findings.rationale: Same ‘…’ thought markup as surrounding interior monologue; speech comes later with the rebuilt illusion.

findings.correction: For an instant, it seemed a sneer crossed his opaque face.
findings.current: For an instant, it seemed that a sneer appeared on his translucent face.
findings.defect: 불투명한 is opaque, not translucent; the figure was 투명한 earlier.
findings.rationale: 불투명 explicitly negates transparency; translucent splits the difference the Korean does not.
findings.source: 얼핏 그의 불투명한 얼굴에 비웃음이 떠오르는 듯했다.

summary: One critical subject reversal on Seong Jinho waking Taekyung; several major losses of Murim identity, coping-thought causality, form numbering, and register, plus System/footnote formatting defects.
